scripts.build: npm run check:wrangler-configs && npm run build --workspace @elm-chat/web && npm run build --workspace @elm-chat/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @elm-chat/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @elm-chat/crypto && npm run typecheck --workspace @elm-chat/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @elm-chat/api
scripts.deploy: npm run check:wrangler-configs && npm run build --workspace @elm-chat/web && CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID="${ELM_CHAT_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:-$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID}" wrangler deploy -c wrangler.jsonc
